newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Otter Gold loses appeal to PosGold.
newsitem.headline: Otter Gold loses appeal to PosGold.

text.p: Otter Gold Mines Ltd said on Thursday it had lost a judgement in the Appeal Court to PosGold Group over the Martha Hill mine in the Coromandel.
Otter said it was considering appealling to the Privy Council.
The decision means Otter has to return NZ$3.3 million to PosGold, the damages sum it was paid after the High Court judgement.

The original award of lost opportunity damages had been made in March 1996 in respect of loss caused by PosGold's acquisition in June 1993 of Amax Gold's interest in the Martha Hill Joint Venture in breach of the joint venture agreement.
